oneLiner: Local-first tools — nothing leaves your phone unless you choose a network feature.

features.title: On your device
features.body: Your data stays on the phone by default. No account required for the template shell.

features.title: One legal source
features.body: Privacy and terms stay in sync with the mobile app via sync:legal — hosted /privacy for the stores.

features.title: Store-ready
features.body: Ship iOS and Android from the same product identity when you are ready.
